The Markdown fixtures are paraphrased, anonymized variants of the public [HackerOne policy](https://hackerone.com/security?type=team&view_profile=true) and [YesWeHack policy](https://yeswehack.com/programs/yes-we-hack). Organization names and assets use fictional identities, and rule details are adjusted to cover the extraction cases. Tests use local responses and never contact the programs or an AI provider.
